theme: An open day, with the trip clock ticking.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today, Dan — the day is yours. The real pull this week is the pre-Croatia booking list, and several of its pieces close before Monday's departure.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: P1 in your travel list, due Aug 25 — the issued Basic Economy ticket shows zero checked bags. Verify it on the operating carrier's site and buy bags online before the Sept 8 departure, not at the airport counter.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night
needsAttention.detail: P1, due Aug 26 — the last night after the charter, airport-side in Cavtat. Charter connectivity is poor, so this has to be booked from dry land before you fly out Monday.

needsAttention.title: Book the St Pete landing gap, Sept 20 to 22
needsAttention.detail: P1, due Aug 25 — two nights between the Croatia landing and Tuesday's school pickup, before the Orlando villa starts.

needsAttention.title: Lock or drop the car-rental hedge
needsAttention.detail: P2, due Aug 28 — a refundable Full-Size SUV backup unless Mike's car is confirmed en route. The call locks Sept 7, the day before Croatia.

flagged.title: Experian monthly statement
flagged.detail: Your September credit statement posted — routine, nothing new flagged.

inbox.noise: ~40 unread, nearly all promotions and newsletters — Labor Day sales, Airbnb, campaign mail.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Roasted kabocha squash
recipe.why: Autumn brings the first hard squashes into season, sweet and ready for a hot oven.
